findings.summary: Tenant admins can open the history page but cannot load row details
findings.details: The tenant-wide page is routed behind action.redemption.view_all_history, and the test CLIENT_ADMIN fixture intentionally has that permission without action.redemption.view_history. However, row clicks mount the shared TransactionDetailSheet, which calls getRedemptionDetail() against /redemption/requests/{id}. The contract marks that detail endpoint as requiring action.redemption.view_history, not view_all_history, so a real CLIENT_ADMIN can list all tenant transactions but gets a failed detail sheet for any row.
findings.tierReason: severity=high, confidence=0.90 (≥ 0.70), alreadyHandled=false at review time
findings.recommendation: Use can('action.redemption.view_history') from usePermissions() to conditionally render non-interactive rows and skip mounting TransactionDetailSheet when user lacks view_history.
findings.resolution: FE guard applied — canViewDetail = can('action.redemption.view_history'). Rows non-interactive and sheet not mounted when permission absent. 2 Vitest + 1 E2E test added.
